python3 -I - <<'EOF'
import glob,re,collections
rows=[]
for f in sorted(glob.glob('*.txt')):
    t=open(f,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
    n_case=len(re.findall(r'Case Number:',t)); n_dl=len(re.findall(r'Damage Location:',t))
    if n_case!=n_dl: print("MISMATCH",f,n_case,n_dl)
    for m in re.finditer(r'Damage Location:[ \t]*([^\n]*)',t):
        rows.append((f,m.group(1)))
print(len(rows))
nocomma=[r for r in rows if ',' not in r[1]]
print("no comma:",len(nocomma))
for r in nocomma: print(r)
cities=collections.Counter()
withcity=0
for f,loc in rows:
    if ',' not in loc: continue
    c=loc.split(',')[-1].strip().lower()
    if not c: continue
    cities[c]+=1; withcity+=1
print("with city",withcity)
for c,n in cities.most_common(25): print(repr(c),n)
top5=sum(n for _,n in cities.most_common(5))
print("top5",top5, round(100*top5/withcity,2))
EOF

import glob,re,collections
rows=[]; unrec=0; recovered=[]
for f in sorted(glob.glob('*.txt')):
    t=open(f,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').read()
    blocks=re.split(r'(?=Case Number:)',t)[1:]
    for b in blocks:
        m=re.search(r'Damage Location:[ \t]*([^\n]*)',b)
        loc=m.group(1).strip() if m else ''
        if not loc:
            pre=re.split(r'The.{0,3}IURC',b)[0].split('\n')[1:]
            cand=[l.strip() for l in pre if l.strip() and not re.fullmatch(r'[\d/ ]+',l.strip())]
            last=cand[-1] if cand else ''
            if last and ',' in last and re.search(r'\d|Street|St|Road|Ave|Drive|Lane|Rd|Dr|Blvd|Way|Court|Ct',last) and last not in ('Abstentions:',):
                recovered.append((f,last)); loc=last
            else:
                unrec+=1; loc=''
        rows.append((f,loc))
print('cases',len(rows),'recovered',len(recovered),'unrecoverable',unrec)
for r in recovered[:0]: print(r)
cities=collections.Counter(); withcity=0; nocity=0
for f,loc in rows:
    if ',' not in loc: nocity+=1; continue
    c=loc.split(',')[-1].strip().lower()
    if not c: nocity+=1; continue
    cities[c]+=1; withcity+=1
print('with city',withcity,'without',nocity)
for c,n in cities.most_common(8): print(repr(c),n)
top=cities.most_common(5); s=sum(n for _,n in top)
print('top5',top,s,round(100*s/withcity,2))
EOF
